episodes.title: Pee Pee Guy
episodes.summary: A business associate falls from grace, while Ray takes the fall for a mate. A chance meeting in the park and a new apprentice.

episodes.title: Unicorns Know Everybody's Name
episodes.summary: The wrong guy gets the good news and Unicorns do exist. The first of a thousand kisses and good ole revenge.

episodes.title: Captain Obvious
episodes.summary: Anger mismanagement and no such thing as Jesus. If you can't kill your own brother-in-law, who can?

episodes.title: On Behalf of Society
episodes.summary: Ray doesn't like surprises, sit downs, sandwiches, or assholes. Brittany asks tough questions, while Ray hands out trouble to those that seek it.

episodes.title: Hard Worker
episodes.summary: People are not always what they appear to be and a good strong name is important. It's also important to lock one's car.

episodes.title: Your Mum's Got a Strongbox
episodes.summary: A nutritious breakfast is the key to good health. As is looking in the trunk before stealing a car.

episodes.title: Shoulda Tapped
episodes.summary: Ray don't tap but he gives good advice. Sometimes you have to take the scenic route.

episodes.title: Don't Be a Dickhead
episodes.summary: Ray solves problems but under no circumstances does he answer questions.

episodes.title: I Came from Your Balls?
episodes.summary: Ray and Ally get caught out and good dental hygiene is as important as paying your debts.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: Is there really any such thing as monsters?

episodes.title: Can't Save You
episodes.summary: All things must end, even Christmas.

episodes.title: Let Me Stop You There
episodes.summary: Lady troubles, old friends and hearts on trees.

episodes.title: Watch Out for Snakes
episodes.summary: Ray does favours but doesn't forgive.

episodes.title: See You in Your Dreams
episodes.summary: An old friend takes the fall and an associate pays for past misdeeds.

episodes.title: Socks Are Important
episodes.summary: When exiting a department store, make sure you don't leave with less than you came with.

episodes.title: Nice Face
episodes.summary: Enemies may come and go and so, alas do friends.

episodes.title: There Rust, and Let Me Die
episodes.summary: We live, no doubt, but does anybody really die?

episodes.title: Coulda Shoulda
episodes.summary: If your mistakes lead to your death, how can you learn from them?

episodes.title: Champ
episodes.summary: If you think the violence is not the answer, you don't understand the question.

episodes.title: All I Ever Wanted
episodes.summary: You can't make anybody stay but you can sure as hell make 'em go.

episodes.title: Cut the Crap Princess
episodes.summary: Curiosity rarely kills the cat but too many pharmaceuticals generally will.

episodes.title: Before I Went to War
episodes.summary: All is fair in love and war but not in business. Forgiveness may be divine but revenge is way more fun.

episodes.title: Ray Who?
episodes.summary: Don't live in the past they say but what if it's a hell of a lot better than the present?

episodes.title: I'm Your Girl
episodes.summary: Everybody loves a road trip.

episodes.title: I'll See You Soon
episodes.summary: There's a reason why the road less travelled, is less travelled.

episodes.title: I'm Not Leaving
episodes.summary: If nothing ends, what begins?
